datasets.name: rfm_analysis
queryLines:
WITH customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    household_key,
    MAX(day_no) as last_purchase_day,
    COUNT(DISTINCT basket_id) as frequency,
    SUM(net_sales_value) as monetary_value,
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(day_no)
      FROM
        retail_marketing.silver.transaction_clean
    )
      - MAX(day_no) as recency_days
  FROM
    retail_marketing.silver.transaction_clean
  GROUP BY
    household_key
),
rfm_scores AS (
  SELECT
    household_key,
    recency_days,
    frequency,
    monetary_value,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days DESC) as R_score,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency ASC) as F_score,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary_value ASC) as M_score
  FROM
    customer_metrics
)
SELECT
  household_key,
  recency_days,
  frequency,
  monetary_value,
  R_score,
  F_score,
  M_score,
  CONCAT(R_score, F_score, M_score) as RFM_segment,
  CASE
    WHEN
      R_score >= 4
      AND F_score >= 4
      AND M_score >= 4
    THEN
      'Champions'
    WHEN
      R_score >= 3
      AND F_score >= 3
      AND M_score >= 3
    THEN
      'Loyal Customers'
    WHEN
      R_score >= 3
      AND F_score <= 2
    THEN
      'Potential Loyalists'
    WHEN
      R_score <= 2
      AND F_score >= 3
    THEN
      'At Risk'
    WHEN
      R_score <= 2
      AND F_score <= 2
    THEN
      'Lost'
    ELSE 'Others'
  END as customer_segment
FROM
  rfm_scores

datasets.name: campaign_roi
queryLines:
WITH campaign_costs AS (
  SELECT
    p.WeekNumber,
    CASE
      WHEN
        p.HasDisplay = 'Y'
        AND p.HasMailer = 'Y'
      THEN
        'Display + Mailer'
      WHEN p.HasDisplay = 'Y' THEN 'Display Only'
      WHEN p.HasMailer = 'Y' THEN 'Mailer Only'
      ELSE 'No Promotion'
    END as PromotionType,
    SUM(p.TotalDiscountAmount) as total_discount_cost,
    SUM(p.GrossSalesAmount) as gross_sales,
    SUM(p.NetSalesAmount) as net_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ProductID) as product_count,
    SUM(p.BasketCount) as basket_count
  FROM
    retail_marketing.dm_marketing.dm_promotion_performance p
  GROUP BY
    p.WeekNumber,
    CASE
      WHEN
        p.HasDisplay = 'Y'
        AND p.HasMailer = 'Y'
      THEN
        'Display + Mailer'
      WHEN p.HasDisplay = 'Y' THEN 'Display Only'
      WHEN p.HasMailer = 'Y' THEN 'Mailer Only'
      ELSE 'No Promotion'
    END
),
campaign_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.CampaignKey,
    c.CampaignID,
    c.CampaignDescription,
    c.RedemptionCount,
    c.TargetHouseholdCount,
    c.RedeemingHouseholdCount,
    c.RedemptionRate,
    cc.total_discount_cost,
    cc.gross_sales,
    cc.net_sales,
    cc.basket_count,
    CASE
      WHEN cc.total_discount_cost > 0 THEN (cc.net_sales / cc.total_discount_cost)
      ELSE 0
    END as roi_ratio,
    cc.net_sales - cc.total_discount_cost as net_profit
  FROM
    retail_marketing.dm_marketing.dm_campaign_performance c
      LEFT JOIN campaign_costs cc
        ON 1 = 1
)
SELECT
  CampaignID,
  CampaignDescription,
  RedemptionCount,
  TargetHouseholdCount,
  RedeemingHouseholdCount,
  RedemptionRate,
  total_discount_cost,
  gross_sales,
  net_sales,
  basket_count,
  roi_ratio,
  net_profit,
  CASE
    WHEN roi_ratio >= 3 THEN 'Yüksek ROI'
    WHEN roi_ratio >= 1.5 THEN 'Orta ROI'
    ELSE 'Düşük ROI'
  END as roi_category
FROM
  campaign_metrics

datasets.name: customer_behavior
queryLines:
WITH customer_campaign_activity AS (
  SELECT
    t.household_key,
    t.week_no,
    t.basket_id,
    t.net_sales_value,
    t.quantity,
    CASE
      WHEN t.coupon_match_disc > 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END as used_campaign,
    cp.CampaignID,
    cp.CampaignDescription,
    cp.StartDay / 7 as campaign_start_week,
    cp.EndDay / 7 as campaign_end_week
  FROM
    retail_marketing.silver.transaction_clean t
      LEFT JOIN retail_marketing.demo_dm.vw_campaign_performance cp
        ON t.week_no BETWEEN (cp.StartDay / 7) AND (cp.EndDay / 7)
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    household_key,
    used_campaign,
    COUNT(DISTINCT basket_id) as basket_count,
    SUM(net_sales_value) as total_spend,
    AVG(net_sales_value) as avg_basket_value,
    SUM(quantity) as total_quantity
  FROM
    customer_campaign_activity
  GROUP BY
    household_key,
    used_campaign
)
SELECT
  CASE used_campaign
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Kampanyalı'
    ELSE 'Kampanyasız'
  END as customer_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT household_key) as customer_count,
  SUM(basket_count) as total_baskets,
  AVG(basket_count) as avg_baskets_per_customer,
  SUM(total_spend) as total_revenue,
  AVG(avg_basket_value) as avg_basket_value,
  SUM(total_quantity) as total_units
FROM
  customer_metrics
GROUP BY
  used_campaign

datasets.name: timing_analysis
queryLines:
SELECT
  CAST(t.day_no AS INT) as day_no,
  t.week_no,
  DAYOFWEEK(TO_DATE('2016-01-01') + CAST(t.day_no AS INT)) as day_of_week,
  MONTH(TO_DATE('2016-01-01') + CAST(t.day_no AS INT)) as month_number,
  CASE
    WHEN t.coupon_match_disc > 0 THEN 'Kampanyalı'
    ELSE 'Kampanyasız'
  END as campaign_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CONCAT(CAST(t.household_key AS STRING), '_', CAST(t.day_no AS STRING))
  ) as basket_count,
  SUM(t.net_sales_value) as net_sales,
  AVG(t.net_sales_value) as avg_basket_value,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.household_key) as customer_count,
  CASE DAYOFWEEK(TO_DATE('2016-01-01') + CAST(t.day_no AS INT))
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Pazar'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Pazartesi'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Salı'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Çarşamba'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Perşembe'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Cuma'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Cumartesi'
  END as day_name,
  CASE MONTH(TO_DATE('2016-01-01') + CAST(t.day_no AS INT))
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Ocak'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Şubat'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Mart'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Nisan'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Mayıs'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Haziran'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Temmuz'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'Ağustos'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'Eylül'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'Ekim'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'Kasım'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'Aralık'
  END as month_name
FROM
  retail_marketing.silver.transaction_clean t
GROUP BY
  day_no,
  week_no,
  day_of_week,
  month_number,
  campaign_status,
  day_name,
  month_name
ORDER BY
  day_no

datasets.name: geographic_analysis
queryLines:
WITH store_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    t.store_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.basket_id) as basket_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.household_key) as customer_count,
    SUM(t.net_sales_value) as total_sales,
    AVG(t.net_sales_value) as avg_basket_value,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN t.coupon_match_disc > 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) as campaign_transactions,
    COUNT(t.basket_id) as total_transactions,
    SUM(t.coupon_match_disc) as total_discount
  FROM
    retail_marketing.silver.transaction_clean t
  GROUP BY
    t.store_id
)
SELECT
  store_id,
  basket_count,
  customer_count,
  total_sales,
  avg_basket_value,
  campaign_transactions,
  total_transactions,
  total_discount,
  ROUND(campaign_transactions * 100.0 / total_transactions, 2) as campaign_adoption_rate,
  ROUND(total_sales / customer_count, 2) as revenue_per_customer
FROM
  store_metrics
ORDER BY
  total_sales DESC

datasets.name: basket_analysis
queryLines:
SELECT
  p.CommodityDescription as category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CONCAT(CAST(t.household_key AS STRING), '_', CAST(t.day_no AS STRING))
  ) as basket_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.household_key) as customer_count,
  SUM(t.net_sales_value) as total_sales,
  AVG(t.net_sales_value) as avg_item_value,
  SUM(t.quantity) as total_quantity,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN t.coupon_match_disc > 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) as promotion_count,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN t.coupon_match_disc > 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    )
      * 100.0
      / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) as promotion_rate
FROM
  retail_marketing.silver.transaction_clean t
    INNER JOIN retail_marketing.dwh.dim_product p
      ON t.product_id = p.ProductID
GROUP BY
  p.CommodityDescription
ORDER BY
  total_sales DESC
